notes.title: You can now easily spot enemies!
notes.notes: Just hold enemies at gunpoint and you will spot them for your teammates.

notes.title: New mobs to shoot and protect.
notes.notes:
Seems like everyone liked spooky bugs. So I've forced the idea and now we have 6 different NPCs (with procedural variations).
They all are waiting for you in the game ;)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615890/ccc0811e1085ef0325b094e7940bfd08bcf4d884.png[/img]

notes.title: It's Halloween!
notes.notes:
Hope you'll like those spooky bugs and bulldogs!
...and a bunch of fixes and performance improvements too ;)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615890/5442ed0c8ac2db20355613363ce48d8949464661.png[/img]

notes.title: AI update!
notes.notes:
Lots of AI fixes and tweaking.
Protectors (bugs and bulldogs) now have weaker weapons (but not "weak").
Player's weapon unlocks have more sense now (theoretically the more you play, the better the weapon).
All bots now have medium quality weapons.
Protectors spawn was fixed (sometimes they were too slow to enable shields).
And some more fixes.
Let me know in the forums if something is wrong.

So, what's next?
New game mode ;)

Droo.

notes.title: New location in VOLTED!
notes.notes:
Desert Mountains are now volted too!
Native robo scorpions weren't happy about that, so they had to join a battle for electricity.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615890/0651fea24e8e95ae6f521e1fb5758aebd98bab43.png[/img]

notes.title: Polish and simplified Chinese languages are available!
notes.notes: That was harder than we expected, but It's a good news! More players from those great countries are welcome ;)

notes.title: More languages arrived!
notes.notes: Volted now has support for English, German, French, Spanish, Czech, Ukrainian and Russian languages.

notes.title: Localization!
notes.notes: In the last few updates we began to localize the game. First 2 languages are Russian and Ukrainian. We are searching for volunteers to translate to other languages. If you want to help us to translate this game to your language please leave a comment ;)

notes.title: Winter has come!
notes.notes:
New map with new protectors!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615890/31b57ac8faa27df0bbfaabc42bea0822527e6ed6.png[/img]

Bulldogs can equip up to 3 weapons and can use tank and artillery weapons.

And bring your friends, VOLTED is on sale right now ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615890/9d178dbdb407d0bcea03dc13a8b31471573ba1b0.png[/img]

notes.title: Base VS Base!
notes.notes:
New game mode has arrived!
Go blow up enemy base and don't forget to protect yours at the same time.
There are also a lot of tweaks to bugs and AI, so please leave your feedback in the forums.
Also shotguns are now more powered, maybe too much. Will see till the next big update.

Next step - Winter Map.

See you on the battlefield.
- Droo

notes.title: Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Game Modes
notes.notes:
What to do next?

I don't have an order, but here is a list what to do:

1) Update for bugs
2) New map "style" (for example desert or snow)
3) New game mode (base vs base)

What do you think I need to do first?

PS: mini map is in the game, right now working on a balance and AI. And a new steam page with a new trailer is coming soon.

notes.title: First week!
notes.notes:
Hey, my Volted friends, it's been a week in Early Access. Lot's of patches and gameplay fixes, thanks to your feedback.

People gather to play in our Discord, you can join too https://discord.gg/zk84QFH

So what's next?
Mini map is in the works!
Since levels are randomly generated, sometimes it could be difficult to figure out the  best path to your objective. I've seen many times when two teams sitting in a bottleneck for 5 minutes, eventually one team loses of course. My hope is that mini map will help you to see an alternative routes to tesla towers.

V for Volted.
